description: Plan an A/B test for marketing copy. Give it the current conversion rate, the smallest lift worth detecting and the daily traffic, and it tells you how many visitors each version needs and how many days to run. It also frames the test as two different answers to the same reader question, so the result teaches you something you can reuse, and not just that "B won". Use it when someone asks how long to run a test, how much traffic they need, whether a test is worth running, or what to test next.

baseline_conversion_rate_percent.description: The current conversion rate, in percent, so 3 means 3% and 0.8 means 0.8%.

daily_visitors.description: How many visitors a day enter the test, across all versions.

minimum_detectable_lift_percent.description: The smallest relative lift worth detecting, in percent. 20 means a 20% lift, like going from 3% to 3.6%.

question.description: The reader question both versions answer, each in its own way.

versions.description: How many versions, counting the original.

name: plan_ab_test
title: Plan an A/B test
